privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Aperim Pty Ltd ("we", "us", "our") operates the Production City platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or submit an expression of interest.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.description: When you submit an expression of interest, we collect:
items: Category-specific information (e.g., company name, portfolio URL)
Technical data: IP address, browser type, referring page, UTM campaign parameters
Consent records: privacy policy version accepted, timestamp, marketing preference

purpose.title: How We Use Your Information
purpose.description: We use the information we collect to:
items: Respond to your expression of interest
Send a confirmation email acknowledging your submission
Send marketing communications (only if you opted in)
Analyse submission trends to improve our services

lawfulBasis.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
lawfulBasis.consent: Consent: We process your expression of interest based on your explicit consent, indicated by accepting this privacy policy.
lawfulBasis.legitimateInterest: Legitimate interest: We send operational emails (confirmation of submission) based on our legitimate interest in providing the service you requested.
lawfulBasis.marketing: Marketing: Marketing communications are sent only with your explicit opt-in consent and you may withdraw consent at any time.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.description: We retain expression of interest data for up to 24 months after the last point of contact. After this period, data is anonymised or deleted. You may request earlier deletion at any time.

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParties.description: We share your data with the following service providers:
items: Postmark (Wildbit LLC): Email delivery for confirmation and marketing communications
Cloudflare: Website hosting, CDN, and security services
thirdParties.note: These providers process data on our behalf under data processing agreements. We do not sell your personal data.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.description: Under applicable privacy legislation, you have the right to:
items: Access the personal data we hold about you
Lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@production.city.

jurisdiction.title: Governing Law
jurisdiction.description: This privacy policy is governed by the laws of New South Wales, Australia, and the Australian Privacy Act 1988.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. The consent version recorded with your submission refers to the version of this policy you accepted.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of the Production City website operated by Aperim Pty Ltd.

usage.title: Use of Website
usage.description: You may use this website for lawful purposes only. You agree not to use this website in any way that could damage, disable, or impair the website or interfere with any other party's use.
